_comment: Tier-2: for POINT_LOAD on NODES use AssignVectorVariableProcess; there is no AssignVectorByDirectionProcess class on StructuralMechanicsApplication, and the CORE python module of that name genuinely fails on load variables because it tries to fix/free the DOF. Pitfall (kratos.linear_elasticity #6). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). This is the linear_elasticity copy; the structural_dynamics copy (#6 there) has its own fixture, point_load_direction_process_rejects. Measured: SMA.AssignVectorByDirectionProcess raises AttributeError (route (a) of the claim), while the core modules assign_vector_by_direction_process, assign_vector_variable_process and assign_vector_by_direction_to_condition_process all import and all expose Factory — so the directional process really does exist as a core module, which is what makes route (b) reachable and the claim's two-failure-mode structure correct. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
